versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Added a GIPHY logo image to the documentation for improved branding.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core features or functionality.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

- Initial release of the giphy-media skill.
- Search GIFs, stickers, emojis, and trending content from GIPHY within chat.
- Upload media to GIPHY using a secure ClawLink connection (no manual API configuration required).
- Setup instructions included for installing the required ClawLink plugin and connecting GIPHY.
- All GIPHY tool access is managed through ClawLink’s integration hub.
- Clear usage rules and step-by-step guidance provided for pairing and media actions.
